_comment: Depth gate D — mutation testing. Scoped to the engine CORE (rule-engine + the selector factory) where a survived mutant is a real test hole; deliberately NOT the whole surface. Uses the command runner because this repo drives a bespoke vm/classic-script harness no framework plugin understands; coverageAnalysis must be 'off' for the command runner, so each mutant reruns the whole command — hence tests/mutation-run.js is a fast, single-process, in-process oracle (~0.24s, no child spawns) rather than the 24s full run-all. Run with `npm run test:mutation` (~3 min). Kept OUT of per-PR CI: a legitimate refactor can move the score, so this is a periodic/manual gate, not a PR blocker. Baseline score at introduction: 53.40% (rule-engine 58.73%, factory 44.94%); break is set below that as a RATCHET — raise it as the oracle grows, never lower it.
